hero.title: Built in Jordan. Trusted across the region.
hero.subtitle: A Jordanian group of three companies: cross-border transport, project services and border logistics, founded by one family and run to one standard.

story.title: From a single transport license in 2008 to a group of three companies.
story.body: Abu Sonbul was established in Jordan in 2008 by Mr. Raed Abdel Fatah Abu Sonbul, on one transport licence. As the work grew it separated into three companies rather than one sprawling one: Abu Sonbul Arab Transporters for cross-border freight, Raed Abu Sonbul & Partner for everything a remote project needs to operate, and Abu Sonbul For Logistic Services for moving goods through Jordan's border crossings. Each stands on its own, with its own fleet, crews and clients, and together they cover a shipment from the loading bay to the far side of the border and out to the site.

companies.title: Three companies, one owner.
companies.subtitle: Separating the businesses means each one is judged on its own work, and it means you deal with specialists rather than a generalist.

founder.name: Mr. Raed Abdel Fatah Abu Sonbul
points: Over 30 years of experience in logistics, transport and project management.
Strong leadership in executing large-scale projects in Jordan.
Visionary approach in growing the Abu Sonbul group into new markets.
Committed to delivering excellence and building long-term partnerships.
Personally directed the ADNOC Azraq and Sarhan camp programmes: 2+ years of full-service delivery including camp construction, cross-border transport from the UAE, catering and housekeeping.
Led the ARGAS Al-Jaffr project in southern Jordan, overseeing cross-border freight from Saudi Arabia, full camp construction and daily site operations.
Built and scaled a team of over 250 professionals across six specialised departments.
Established long-term partnerships with major energy sector operators including ADNOC, ARGAS and government entities.
